thread:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: PAGERDUTY — service=inference-edge-east1 severity=high — automated page fired at 3925001111 :rotating_light:
PagerDuty: PAGER 5XX_EDGE_SURGE assigned to @Alex — escalate in 5m if unacked
Alex: acked — I'm on it, grabbing logs and checking routing tables
Priya: seeing alerts in eu-west and us-east. error-rate ~18% 5xx on edge-proxy layer, spike started ~10m ago
Ryan: confirmed. 5xxs are mostly 502/504 from edge->origin pool, upstream health flapping. stack traces show keepalive reset and connection backoff
Maria: customer-facing metric: approx 4.3k affected requests/min, ~12% of active sessions experiencing degraded responses. No PagerDuty customer page yet but support logs show two enterprise customers emailing support
Alex: quick repo of recent deploys? any canary out?
SRE-ops: no infra deploys flagged in last 30m. Rolling job completed 45m ago, unrelated. Network flaps reported by cloud provider in us-east-1 around the same time
Priya: digging into edge proxies — KV cache hit ratio dropped on some hosts, may be triggering synchronous origin fallthroughs
Alex: adding temporary mitigation: switch routing policy to avoid recovering origin pool. I'll push a route override to send 30% traffic to regional-fallback for 10m to reduce error amplification
Ryan: please also disable aggressive retries at the gateway level (reduce to 0->1) to avoid request storming the origin. I'll update retry-config in the edge policy
Maria: running a quick canary to validate: curl against fallback and primary endpoints, comparing latency and success rates
Alex: pushing override now — command pasted for audit:
```
# route override
rdwctl routes apply --service inference-edge-east1 --selector region=us-east --weight primary=70,fallback=30 --ttl 600
```
Alex: override applied — pushing to observability
incident-bot: Route override change detected by deploy-bot (change id r-89231)
Priya: logs after override: error-rate in primary down from 18% -> 9% within 60s. fallback handling OK, a few increased latencies but success rate stable
SRE-ops: initiated origin node recycle for the unhealthy origin pool (rolling restart, 2 nodes at a time). ETA ~12m to finish
PagerDuty: Reminder — if unacked escalate to @Ryan after 5m
Ryan: acked as secondary. I'll stay on for the next handoff
Maria: customer impact note for timeline: start=3925000500 ~10m before page, peak error-rate 18% at 3925001080, mitigated to ~6-9% after route override at 3925001150. Affected customers: corp-acme (partial requests), finco (sporadic timeouts) — support notified
Alex: running post-mit healthcheck script against pooled origins. snippet:
```
for host in $(cat origin-list.txt); do
  curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" http://$host/health || echo "host $host failed"
done
```
Priya: origin health checks showing intermittent connection resets on node-3 and node-7 — those are targeted for immediate maintenance
SRE-ops: kicked maintenance on node-3, draining connections, replacing certs and bumping keepalive timeout. node-7 scheduled next in 3m
Alex: telemetry shows overall token-generation latency increased ~120ms on fallback but user-visible success is higher. This is acceptable for a mitigation window
Ryan: starting a suppressed alert for noisy PD alerts — reducing paging noise while we stabilize. Will keep an eye on escalation timers
Maria: drafting a short customer status update for support to send — will include ETA for full restoration and workaround (retry after 5s). Putting the draft in #support-updates
PagerDuty: note — alert suppressed by @Ryan until 3925001900 (suppression id s-77b)
incident-bot: autoscaler triggered +2 proxy pods in us-east as load spikes resumed briefly; load on fallback remains within thresholds
Priya: origin recycle complete for node-3, health checks now 200 OK. node-7 still flapping but draining in progress
Alex: preparing to hand off to night oncall in 25m. @Ryan are you taking first-hand handoff once nodes stabilized?
Ryan: yes, I'll own the 1st handoff. If behavior recurs, escalate to platform infra team. Leaving notes in the runbook
Maria: adding runbook link and remediation checklist:
- runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/inference-edge-5xx
- checklist: disable retries on gateway, apply route override, drain bad origin nodes, recycle, monitor error-rate and customer impact
SRE-ops: logged incident ticket INC-2026 with short description and remediation actions
Alex: final quick check — rolling average error-rate at 3925001290 is 6.2% down from 18%. we'll keep route override for 20 more minutes then re-evaluate. I'm moving to standby
Ryan: acknowledged handoff. I'll monitor until 3925001900 and update incident ticket with timeline and postmortem action items
Maria: thanks team. I'll coordinate support comms and compile logs for the postmortem. Also will attach the PD trace and deploy-bot event
incident-bot: PagerDuty assignment cleared for @Alex — handoff to @Ryan recorded. If errors spike above 12% again, PD will re-page
PagerDuty: alert resolved for now (suppression active). If escalation required, page group infra-sre
Alex: logging out — good job. :thumbsup:
Ryan: keeping it warm. ping me if anything odd shows up.
Maria: closing the thread for now; will reopen if we need active coordination.
